Olenko sopiva tähän työhön? Räätälöi ansioluetteloni Job Description Advisory Solution Consultant – Identity Security Remote (Finland) – Successful applicants must be resident in Finland with right to work. Language requirements – Fluent (spoken/written) in English & Finnish. Full-time position. Who we are: SailPoint is the leader in identity security, helping organisations manage and govern access to applications, systems, and data – for every identity type. As enterprises continue to adopt cloud technologies and non-human services, identity has become a critical foundation for modern security. SailPoint powers organisations to manage access at scale while maintaining strong governance, compliance, and visibility. Everything at SailPoint is driven by our four key values: Innovation – we develop creative solutions to real challenges. Integrity – we deliver on the commitments we make. Impact – we measure and reward results, not activity. Individuals – we value every person at SailPoint for their unique talents. The job posting starts with our culture, as it is so important to our continued success. You can be assured of a trusting and supportive environment, which will challenge and reward in equal measure. Growth is also hugely important, and you can also be confident of finding a role which offers development and progression, in addition to competitive renumeration and generous benefits. What your role includes: Advisory Solution Consultants at SailPoint combine technical expertise with customer engagement to help organisations solve complex identity and security challenges. Work closely with sales teams and customer stakeholders. You will demonstrate how SailPoint’s platform enables organisations to securely manage access across their environments. Key Responsibilities Partner with Account Executives to support sales opportunities. Engage with customer stakeholders to discover and refine identity and security challenges. Deliver compelling technical demonstrations of SailPoint solutions. Design solution approaches aligned to customer environments. Support proof-of-value engagements and technical evaluations. Translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes. Collaborate with partners and internal teams across sales, product, and engineering. Who Thrives in This Role? Advisory Solution Consultants at SailPoint come from a variety of backgrounds, but the people who thrive here tend to share a few common traits. You will be a great fit if you: Embrace a growth mindset – you are naturally curious and welcome the ability to continually learn and develop your skills. Like combining technical depth with storytelling and business value. Enjoy collaborating with others and sharing knowledge across teams. Are comfortable leading conversations with both technical experts and senior stakeholders. Take ownership of opportunities and enjoy helping customers succeed. Above all, successful SEs at SailPoint enjoy helping customers solve real-world security challenges while working as part of a supportive and collaborative team. Who are we looking for? You have a strong understanding of SaaS solutions, and how they operate. You have a strong understanding or experience in Identity and key identity principles. You have an understanding or experience with IaaS environments (Azure, AWS, GCP). You have an understanding or experience with AI-driven solutions. You are comfortable presenting professionally to a wide audience – including technical demonstrations. Your written and communication skills are excellent. The lists above are neither exclusive nor exhaustive. At SailPoint, we value the contribution of each of our team members - as a result if you have alternative skills or only limited experience in some areas, please don’t be discouraged. Path to Success: Every new SE receives a tailored on-boarding plan aligned to their skills and experience. As a typical path to success: During months 1-4, you will: Learn the Identity Security and Identity Management space Participate in enablement on demo best practices, presentation skills, and negotiation. Handle initial demos and discussions on the SailPoint platform. Attend Revenue Onboarding for a deep dive into SailPoint sales methodology. Hone technical discovery skills during reviews with your peers. Navigate internal relationships with Customer Success Managers, Product Management, Professional Services, and Partners. Coordinate with AEs before and after client calls, tying what is presented back to business value. During months 5-12 you will: Contribute to building new technical collateral use across the SE organisation. Grow familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOX, HIPAA, NERC-CIP, GDPR, and CCPA Speak at national or regional conferences and meet ups. Proactively network and build your own personal brand. Articulate the business value of SailPoint as a strategic sale. Communicate at business level with clients outside of IT, such as HR, Finance, Compliance, Legal Counsel and Business-Unit Owners. Become fluent in the language of Identity Security Ready to apply? Please follow the link in this job advert to apply or reach out to the author of this listing for more details. We’ll be in touch. SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.   Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint. paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Advisory Solutions Consultant position within SailPoint's team. The opportunity to work across international contract law, IP, and privacy law at a globally recognised company is exactly the kind of environment I have been working towards – and I am confident my background makes me a strong fit.

I hold an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and have practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in a corporate legal practice. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5–7 commercial agreements per month – NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts – while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. More recently, I completed a professional language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu, where I worked directly within a Finnish law firm environment, developing my Finnish legal vocabulary and observing local legal processes first-hand.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

SailPoint's in-house model – working directly alongside the General Counsel and gaining exposure to corporate-level legal operations – is precisely the learning environment I am seeking. I am available for the September 2026 start and can commit to the part-time schedule during the academic year, transitioning to full-time over summer.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
